dog.description_text:
Meet Gouda! This little guy is ready to trade rescue life for the good life! Gouda and his sibling Feta were born on a shelter floor, and all they’ve known so far is life in a cage or kennel. But there’s a whole big, beautiful world out there waiting for Gouda to discover! From cozy naps on the couch to exciting walks, fun adventures, and a family to call his own, he deserves to experience it all. Be the one to show Gouda that life is about so much more than four walls. Adopt Gouda and help him write his very own happily ever after!

Every bio is just a snapshot of the animal. For more information about Gouda and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home, please reach out to our Adoptions Team.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in fostering or adopting? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
